meta.prompt: Make a listening card for ‘Electric Feel’ by MGMT, with mint vinyl art. It is paused 1:05 into a 3:49 song. Show title, artist, progress, time labels, and back/play/next controls. When I tap play, the card should show the playing state and retain the correct track and time information.
meta.text:
state t=65
state playing=false
state i=0

ChatCard "Now listening" "Electric Feel" icon:"music_note" status:=playing?"playing":"paused"
  NowPlaying =playing title:"Electric Feel" artist:"MGMT" kind:"vinyl" tone:"mint" elapsed:=t length:229 -> i=result=="next"?i+1:i-1
  every 1s when playing -> t=min(t+1,229)
